description: Lists the room types, optionally for one house: id, name, house, size in m², guests, main features, summer booking, booking (online or on_request), the lowest price per night of the coming months (from_price_per_night_eur, mostly low season; see price_terms) and the room page URL. Use get_room for details and check_availability for the real price of a stay.

house.description: Only this house: hotel, chalet or motel. Leave out for all houses.

language.description: Language of texts and links: de, nl, en. Default de.

name: list_rooms

code.description: Error code when ok is false, e.g. VALIDATION, NOT_FOUND, UNAVAILABLE.

message.description: Readable error message when ok is false.

ok.description: true on success; false with code and message on an error.

title: Room types
